approval_evidence.quote: Initial U.S. Approval: 2021 (Vaxneuvance prescribing information, FDA CBER)

series_start_reason: FDA approved Vaxneuvance in July 2021, but Merck prints no Vaxneuvance sales for 2021 by quarter: the only 2021 figure is the full-year 3 (million) in the 2023 Form 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000162828024006850/mrk-20231231.htm, row 'Vaxneuvance 665 | 170 | 3'), which cannot be split into quarters without interpolation. The 2021 and 2022 releases and 10-Qs carry no Vaxneuvance sales line; the first printed quarterly figures are the 2022 prior-year columns of the 2023 releases (2022Q1-Q3) and the fourth-quarter 2022 release text (2022Q4).
search_log: searched the text of every 2021-2022 earnings release and every 2021-2022 10-Q/10-K table for Vaxneuvance sales: only regulatory news, and in the 2023-02-02 release a sentence giving 2022Q4 sales
Vaxneuvance first appears as a sales-table line in the first-quarter 2023 release and 10-Q
sum of the four quarters is 664 against a printed 2023 full year of 665 (rounding); 2024 and 2025 sums equal the printed full years

listed Merck & Co. (CIK 310158) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus every filings.files page), all forms, then kept 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02 and 10-Q/10-K. No 8-K/A lists item 2.02 (8-K/As 2006-2026 list only items 9.01, 7.01, 5.07 or 5.02); the 2019-02-01 8-K/A, filed the day of the Q4 2018 results, contains only an exhibit 99.2

legacy Merck registrant (CIK 64978, which before the November 2009 merger with Schering-Plough was a separate filer; CIK 310158 was Schering-Plough until then) listed the same way for 2006-2009 earnings releases and 10-Qs
downloaded the EX-99.1 of every item 2.02 8-K from 2006 to 2026-08-04 (85 releases); two item 2.02 filings (2013-02-19, 2022-04-21) are not quarterly results releases and carry no product line
read the product rows with scripts/build.py (HTML table rows, same row reading as the verifier) and cross-checked each quarter against the prior-year column of the following year's release

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: Listed Merck (CIK 310158) 10-Q/10-K/8-K 2021-07 to 2022-05.; FY2021 10-K: FDA approval July 2021, EC approval December 2021, ACIP vote October 2021. Q3 2021 and Q4 2021 releases and 10-Qs have no Vaxneuvance sales line. FY2023 10-K row "Vaxneuvance 665 | 170 | 3" gives 2021 = 3, with no quarterly split.; No Merck document found stating a launch month or quarter, so launch_quarter is null (FDA approval is not a launch).
